text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――Now, the decisive moment!! Every 
Umamusume is making their final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is it Bubble!? Or is it Air!? Bubble!? Or 
Air!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――Behold the run of the "Empress"!! Feat 
your eyes upon it!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is hereee!!! It's Air Groove!!! 
Air Groove!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Amazing...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Air Groove crosses the finish line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a terrifying Umamusume!! She is truly 
frightening!! She has overtaken Bubble Gum 
Fellow!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is this truly the running of a Tiara 
Umamusume!? She overpowered them!! 
Overpowering with sheer might, the 
"Empress" Air Groove!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
T-That was insane...!! Seriously, what the 
hell was that final kick just now...?! 
I've never seen a Tiara Umamusume like 
that before...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
To defeat Bubble Gum Fellow head-on...! 
That's incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has surged right to the top as 
the strongest...! What an incredible era 
we're in...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That was truly an amazing run. ...Today 
was a complete defeat for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I certainly accomplished one thing today. 
However... my battle with you has only 
just begun.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"With today's victory, I believe I've 
finally caught up to you, who had always 
been ahead of me."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The real showdown begins next, Bubble. 
Don't drop your guard.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to push even further beyond who 
I am today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, I see—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (――It's similar.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(We have walked different paths until now, 
and though they crossed today here at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(An unseen strength. Potential. The 
future. And the will to forge ahead toward 
it)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(They surely carry something very similar 
deep down—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(That is why... I want to win so 
badly...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is my next battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we cross paths— I will win next time as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, what did you think of Air 
Groove today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Air Groove's running today, there was a 
power that unlocked the potential of 
Umamusume and pointed the way to the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coincidentally... It mirrored the time 
Bubble Gum Fellow challenged the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) as a Classic-class runner.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"You know, I realized something too. Air 
Groove and I actually have a lot in 
common."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And... that's precisely why— I have to 
surpass Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Only by achieving a complete victory over 
her can I truly become the "vanguard" and 
forge ahead past everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I can reach an unseen strength that will 
turn the racing world upside down...!
choice_data_list: Then let's go. To the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race of fated rivals, where Bubble Gum 
Fellow had felt such bitter disappointment 
last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, she will achieve a decisive 
victory over a fellow trailblazer—the one 
she must surpass now...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I've popped off to the absolute max...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow's next goal was 
set as the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Good work. Care for some coffee today?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've got student council duties to 
attend to as well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You really are a hard worker. I think I'll 
go with orange juice today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...... I'm going to the 『Japan Cup』.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I already said my piece.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. So next, it's our turn.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――I'll beat you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Bring it on, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one else heard that quiet exchange. 
Time simply marched on toward the decisive 
battle—
